definitions.text: Raptor-parseable Markdown and Raptor's SQL store are what judge-jev works with: it reads records only through Raptor and sends every Jev request through one batch command.
A target mode (`--mode prompt|skill|task|code`) names what the judged location is; its target class is agent text (`prompt`, `skill`, `task`) or code.
